_file_note: Notes for app/data/model/pitch_parts.json: where each field came from, who writes and reads it, and the rules it must obey. The field's type, allowed answers, required-ness and column type live with the class in app/models/. Merged by app/repositories/model_catalogue_repository.py.
about: The parts of life a pitch can touch, and the words that signal each. A persona fact tagged with a part reaches a fact prompt when the pitch mentions it.
rules: Words name subject matter only, never good or bad. A word ending in * matches any ending.
Every part is used by at least one persona fact (test_persona_fact_prompts).

price.note: True when a stated rand price also counts as touching this part.
